d:
A humanoid android with a cracked, porcelain-white synthetic face and a singular glowing yellow eye. The build is slender and skeletal with exposed mechanical joints and wires. It wears a tattered, ash-gray hooded cloak draped over a metallic chassis. It possesses three long, sharp metallic claws on each hand and a thin, whip-like mechanical tail.
BODY COLOR: porcelain white
